command: src/delm_cb/cli.py run -n flash-ref-delm-shard1of4 -s flash-shard1of4 -m vertex_ai/gemini-3.8-flash --agent-config configs/reference_medium.yaml -c 2 --key-slot 1 --dataset-dir _shards/flash-shard1of4 --logs-dir logs --results-dir results --no-auto-eval
agent_config:
# Reference agent config, thinking level: medium. Matches CooperBench/configs/reference/medium.yaml.
agent:
  cost_limit: 40.0
  step_limit: 500
  compaction_token_trigger: 128000
  step_counter: true

environment:
  container_timeout: "10h"

model:
  model_kwargs:
    drop_params: true
    thinkingConfig:
      thinkingLevel: medium
      includeThoughts: true
